enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Combat Mastery +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Insightful Doublestrike 3%: Passive: 3% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Armor-Piercing 12%: Passive: +12% Enhancement bonus to Fortification Bypass. (Fortification Bypass makes your attacks ignore a percentage of enemy Fortification.)
Insightful Fortitude Save +3: This item gives a +3 Insight bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
